notebooks.title: 离线区域与KKT证书
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
G=np.array([1.,-1.,1.,-1.])
w=np.array([1.,1.,2.,2.])
S=np.array([[0.,0.],[0.,0.],[-1.,0.],[1.,0.]])
F=np.array([2.,-2.])
regions=[
 dict(id='R0',A=np.array([[-1,1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,-1]]),b=np.array([2,2,4,4]),K=np.array([-.5,.5]),c=0.,active=None,polygon=[[-3,-1],[-1,-3],[3,1],[1,3]]),
 dict(id='R1',A=np.array([[1,-1],[1,0]]),b=np.array([-2,1]),K=np.zeros(2),c=1.,active=0,polygon=[[-3,-1],[1,3],[-3,3]]),
 dict(id='R2',A=np.array([[-1,1],[-1,0]]),b=np.array([-2,1]),K=np.zeros(2),c=-1.,active=1,polygon=[[-1,-3],[3,-3],[3,1]]),
 dict(id='R3',A=np.array([[-1,-1],[-1,0]]),b=np.array([-4,-1]),K=np.array([-1.,0.]),c=2.,active=2,polygon=[[1,3],[3,1],[3,3]]),
 dict(id='R4',A=np.array([[1,1],[1,0]]),b=np.array([-4,-1]),K=np.array([-1.,0.]),c=-2.,active=3,polygon=[[-3,-3],[-1,-3],[-3,-1]])
]
def lookup(x,r,tol=0):
    if abs(x)>3 or abs(r)>3:return None
    theta=np.array([x,r]);hits=[p for p in regions if np.all(p['A']@theta<=p['b']+tol)]
    if not hits:return None
    p=hits[0];u=float(p['K']@theta+p['c'])
    lam=np.zeros(4)
    if p['active'] is not None:
        i=p['active'];lam[i]=-(4*u+F@theta)/G[i]
    slack=w+S@theta-G*u
    residual=max(0.,float(max(-slack)),float(max(-lam)),float(abs(4*u+F@theta+G@lam)),float(max(abs(lam*slack))))
    return dict(region=p['id'],hits=[p['id'] for p in hits],u=u,next=x+u,cost=(x+u-r)**2+u*u,slack=slack,lam=lam,residual=residual,violation=max(0.,float(max(-slack))))
def original_qp(x,r):
    lower=max(-1.,-2.-x);upper=min(1.,2.-x)
    if lower>upper:return None
    cost=lambda u:(x+u-r)**2+u*u
    if lower==upper:u=lower
    else:
        opt=minimize_scalar(cost,bounds=(lower,upper),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-12})
        if not opt.success:raise RuntimeError(opt.message)
        u=min([lower,upper,opt.x],key=cost)
    return dict(u=u,next=x+u,cost=cost(u))
def area(vertices):
    a=np.array(vertices);return abs(float(np.sum(a[:,0]*np.roll(a[:,1],-1)-a[:,1]*np.roll(a[:,0],-1)))/2)

for p in regions:
    i=p['active']
    if i is None:
        K=-F/4;c=0.;lamK=np.zeros(2);lamc=0.
    else:
        K=S[i]/G[i];c=w[i]/G[i]
        lamK=-(4*K+F)/G[i];lamc=-4*c/G[i]
    assert np.allclose(K,p['K']) and abs(c-p['c'])<1e-12
    print('KKT_region',p['id'],'gain',K,'offset',c,'lambda_gain',lamK,'lambda_offset',lamc)
    for point in p['polygon']:
        z=np.array(point);u=float(K@z+c);lam=np.zeros(4)
        if i is not None:lam[i]=lamK@z+lamc
        assert np.all(w+S@z-G*u>=-1e-12) and min(lam)>=-1e-12
        assert abs(4*u+F@z+G@lam)<1e-12
print('H',4,'F',F,'original_inequality_rows',4)
print('areas', [area(p['polygon']) for p in regions], 'sum',sum(area(p['polygon']) for p in regions))
print('coefficient_payload_scalars',12*3+5*3,'float64_payload_bytes',(12*3+5*3)*np.dtype('float64').itemsize)
print('offline_KKT_vertices_checked')

cases=[(2.,-1.),(1.,0.),(-2.,1.),(0.,3.),(2.,3.),(-2.,-3.),(1.,3.),(2.,0.),(3.,2.),(0.,0.)]
for x,r in cases:
    p=lookup(x,r);q=original_qp(x,r)
    assert p is not None and q is not None
    assert abs(p['u']-q['u'])<1e-7 and p['residual']<1e-10
    print('case',x,r,'region',p['region'],'hits',p['hits'],'u',p['u'],'next',p['next'],'J',p['cost'])
# At x=3,r=2, both lower-input and upper-state constraints are active.
for t in [0.,1.,2.]:
    lam=np.array([0.,t,2+t,0.])
    assert abs(4*(-1)+2*(3-2)+G@lam)<1e-12
print('degenerate_point_u',-1,'multiplier_family_lower_t_upper_2_plus_t')
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6,6))
for p in regions:
    points=np.array(p['polygon']);ax.fill(points[:,0],points[:,1],alpha=.3,label=p['id'])
ax.plot(2,-1,'ko');ax.set(xlim=(-3.5,3.5),ylim=(-3.5,3.5),xlabel='current x',ylabel='reference r');ax.legend();ax.grid(True)
plt.show()
print('regions_and_shared_boundaries_checked')

closed=[]
for start,ref in [(2.,-1.),(2.5,0.)]:
    x=start;trajectory=[x];inputs=[];max_difference=0.
    for k in range(20):
        p=lookup(x,ref);q=original_qp(x,ref)
        if p is None or q is None or p['residual']>1e-9:raise RuntimeError('Unapproved nominal action')
        max_difference=max(max_difference,abs(p['u']-q['u']))
        inputs.append(p['u']);x=x+p['u'];trajectory.append(x)
    closed.append(dict(start=start,ref=ref,x=trajectory,u=inputs))
    print('closed_loop_start_ref',start,ref,'steps',len(inputs),'last_sample',trajectory[-1],'max_QP_action_difference',max_difference)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(9,6),sharex=True)
for z in closed:
    label='start='+str(z['start'])+', r='+str(z['ref'])
    ax[0].plot(np.arange(21),z['x'],'o-',label=label)
    ax[1].step(np.arange(20),z['u'],where='post',label=label)
ax[0].set(ylim=(-3.5,3.5),ylabel='sampled state');ax[1].set(ylim=(-1.25,1.25),ylabel='input',xlabel='sample k')
for axis in ax:axis.set_xlim(0,20);axis.grid(True);axis.legend()
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('nominal_20_step_loops_checked')

x,r=2.01,0.
exact=lookup(x,r);loose=lookup(x,r,.02)
print('boundary_tolerance_example','exact_u',exact['u'],'loose_u',loose['u'],'loose_violation',loose['violation'],'exact_J',exact['cost'],'loose_J',loose['cost'])
assert abs(loose['violation']-.005)<1e-12
for x,r in [(0.,3.25),(3.25,0.)]:
    print('outside_domain',x,r,'lookup',lookup(x,r),'original_QP_feasible',original_qp(x,r) is not None)
z=lookup(2.8,3.);true_next=1.2*2.8+z['u']
print('model_mismatch_u',z['u'],'nominal_next',z['next'],'actual_a1_2_next',true_next,'next_state_violation',true_next-2)
assert abs(true_next-2.56)<1e-12
print('unreachable_reference_x2_r3',lookup(2,3)['next'],'input',lookup(2,3)['u'],'tracking_error',lookup(2,3)['next']-3)
print('domain_tolerance_and_model_limits_checked')
